correctness.evidence: Independent exact character-table construction and exhaustive class-sum evaluation reproduced every nonzero count, maximum, argmax family, the unique n=10 maximizer, and ray value 4 for n=6..12.

originality.evidence: Blasiak arXiv:1209.2018 explicitly states the prior-known n=10 maximum value 117, so novelty framing for that scalar was removed. No checked source supplied the same complete n<=10 ordered atlas plus n<=12 ray and unique argmax certificate.

value.evidence: After subtracting the prior-known maximum value, the complete certified coefficient atlas, exact zero/nonzero data, ray values, and unique argmax certificate remain reusable benchmark data for Kronecker computations and stability experiments.

literature.title: Blasiak, Kronecker coefficients for one hook shape
literature.finding: Introduction explicitly states that the maximum size of a Kronecker coefficient for n=10 is 117; this is decisive prior art for that numerical fact.
